source: CozyCrazyCraft Villager Quest & Reward Master Bible v0.2, Section 17
core_rule: The player should remember I got this from that village / that road / that hunt. Emeralds are supporting currency; named or unusual items are the emotional payout.

quality_policy: Named signature rewards must never roll a truly bad Quality; randomness chooses which good build, not whether the quest bricks the item.
Hearthlands prized gear has a minimum neutral floor or includes a reforge-material bundle.
Frontier named gear has a neutral-to-positive floor; strong-positive is exciting rather than mandatory on every roll.
Wildlands signatures have guaranteed positive Quality; offer a reroll token when a technically positive roll conflicts badly with weapon identity.
Dread first-clears use a curated strong-positive Quality or a two/three-item choice; final commissions never use blind casino rolls.

Frostforged / Wind-Cut / Harvest-Honed and similar names are presentation aliases or semantic pools over actual Quality Equipment attributes; do not hardcode stat definitions until the live Quality config is frozen.
ownership_rules: Sunscar owns the boomerang identity; THE RED RETURN is not a generic cross-region random reward.
Greenveil's throwing identity is javelin/reach/traversal; the Canopy Glider is its iconic early utility chain reward.
Harvestwood owns axes/scythes/old-road durability and forest-survival identities.
Signature items are chapter/prized rewards, not board-farm currency.
